title: 2022 year-end summary
summary: This year can be summed up in four words: "search", "persistence", "beginning to end", and "breakthrough"
markdown:
This year can be summed up in four words: "search", "persistence", "beginning to end", and "breakthrough"
## Find
- What do you like?
- What kind of person do you want to be?
- What to do in the future
Only when you like something can you have a steady stream of motivation to persevere. Coding is still my favorite thing and I never tire of it.
This year I also saw a lot of interesting products and followed a lot of independent developers. I prefer to be a developer with solid technical skills and creativity.
In the next few years, we will continue to contribute to open source projects.
## Persistence
- exercise
- Contribute code
As of today, I have been exercising for 112 days. This year I have exercised for 778 minutes and run 192 kilometers. Especially running, I can run 5 kilometers in one breath.
After taking over the company's APP development, I came into contact with the Taro framework and created a discussion to further improve the component type declaration. So far, 10 PRs have been submitted, 8 of which have been merged. The miniapp-types project was created, and the component type schema was generated through each small program document.
## Beginning and end
- Solve umijs SSR performance issues
- Improve APP details
- CanIUse function implementation
The front end of Sifu Community's main website relies on the umijs framework. It was found that the memory usage of SSR is too high, and the official maintenance of SSR functions has declined. It had to find a new solution and finally chose nextjs. After half a year of hard work, it finally rebuilt the main website of Sifu Community with nextjs. The server memory usage was reduced by half. It is currently being tested in grayscale.
The community APP was originally not within the scope of my job, but the native APP was no longer able to be maintained, so I took over the reconstruction work of the community APP with my colleagues. I was responsible for the framework and basic function development, and my colleagues were responsible for business function development. When the overall function of the APP was 90% completed, I had no energy to continue to complete the follow-up development. Recently, I used my break time to continue to complete the remaining finishing work and strive to launch it as soon as possible.
The function of CanIUse was proposed by Zakary, a core member of Taro. Due to the numerous attributes of the mini program components, it was expected to provide the function of CanIUse, and it was implemented to live up to expectations.
## Breakthrough
From "searching" to "persistence", from "persistence" to "beginning and end", and then breaking through the bottleneck, I gained a lot.
1. Become a Taro project collaborator and join the Taro Technical Committee
1. Create two open source projects
- https://github.com/robinv8/miniapp-types
- https://github.com/robinv8/daily
## Summary
2022 is a year when the general environment is sluggish, but the heart cannot be decadent. In 2023, thirty years old, I hope everything will get better and better.
